content.title: This Miner Stock Is Soaring 200% After the U.S. Takes a Stake
content.summary: The Trump administration is getting more aggressive in addressing the country’s critical mineral needs.  The White House late Monday approved the Ambler Road Project to “unlock Alaska’s mineral potential.”  Ambler Road is a proposed industrial road stretching hundreds of miles from the Dalton Highway to the Ambler Mining District, which contains deposits of copper, cobalt, gallium, and germanium, among other metals.

content.title: Dimon Says Government Shutdown Won’t Derail Stock Market
content.summary: JPMorgan Chase Chief Executive Jamie Dimon said the recent shutdown is the wrong way to manage the federal government but is unlikely to hurt the stock market in the long term.  “I don’t care what the Democrats or Republicans say,” Dimon said in an interview with Bloomberg TV.  Dimon also weighed in on the U.S. Defense Department taking a 15% stake in MP Materials, America’s largest rare earths miner.
